verdict.rationale: Crossmint's AI-assistants page describes a first-party server that receives an agent's query and returns only the most relevant docs sections, which suggests an official docs-retrieval server an AI helper can connect to. However, the evidence never explicitly calls it an MCP server, and it covers documentation lookup only, not wallet, payment or agent-checkout operations. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that this is an MCP server, an MCP server exposing Crossmint wallet/payments/agent APIs as tools, setup/connection docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
